components.terms_observation: Original Sun BSD/nuclear disclaimer and separate JJ2000 conforming-product restriction retained; technical completeness does not close combination/adoption rights blocker.

review_findings.detail: Final native renderer join/miter regression fails and is retained as partial-native-renderer-failure; renderer origin/concurrency, ImageIO roundtrips and MapFish decoding pass. Do not represent native renderer suite as passed.
JJ2000 conforming-product restriction remains unresolved for proposed combination. No license clearance inferred from complete source or native omission.

Two consumer constant-pool CLibPNGImageWriter name references remain in WMS/GWC. They are class-name preference checks, not active native providers; final actual WMS/printing receipts required for selected path. No native codecLib members, direct JNI-adapter dependencies or service registrations remain.

Marlin witness verifies patched JAR resource origin, version and exact SHA and rejects unpatched/OpenGL paths. ImageIO exercises automatic plus explicit Java TIFF/JP2 providers and exact lossless pixels/geotags; MapFish produces and decodes actual PDF/PNG/TIFF. Builds preserve narrow source exclusions and original archives.

imageio_reproduction_note: Current reviewed recipe includes toolchain verification and recipe hash absent from original imageio-03 receipt; fresh imageio-04 output reproduces selected imageio-03 bytes exactly. Original receipt remains unchanged.
